Metadata.title: Hide Kindle Orders
Metadata.description: A Firefox extension that hides Kindle orders on the Amazon.co.jp order history page.

Hero.tagline: Your order history, minus the Kindle flood.
Hero.description: Buy a few comics a week and your Amazon.co.jp order history turns into a wall of Kindle purchases. This extension hides them with one click, so the things you actually shipped are easy to find again.

Why.title: Amazon gives you no way to filter these out.
Why.description: The order history can be narrowed by year or by keyword, and digital orders can be shown on their own — but there is no way to exclude them. If you read a lot on Kindle, every physical order you want to check a delivery date or a receipt for is buried under a dozen ebook purchases. This extension does the one thing Amazon does not offer: leave the Kindle orders out.

Companions.title: Plays well with
Companions.description: Pages appended by infinite-scroll extensions are scanned too, including the ones that inject them inside an iframe.

toggle.title: One-click toggle
toggle.description: A small button in the bottom right flips between hiding and showing. Translucent at rest so it stays out of the way.

resilient.title: No brittle selectors
resilient.description: Order cards are found by their order-number label rather than by class names, so Amazon's frequent markup changes do not break it.

infiniteScroll.title: Infinite scroll ready
infiniteScroll.description: Re-scans on DOM changes, on AutoPagerize-style events, and on a timer, so page two onwards is filtered as well.

remembers.title: Remembers your choice
remembers.description: The on-off state is stored locally and restored when you open the order history again, iframes included.

privacy.title: Nothing leaves the page
privacy.description: No accounts, no servers, no analytics. It declares no data collection and runs only on Amazon.co.jp order history URLs.

signed.title: Signed by Mozilla
signed.description: Distributed as a signed xpi through AMO's unlisted channel, so release Firefox installs it permanently.

Install.title: Install
Install.step1: Download the xpi from the latest GitHub release.
Install.step2: Open about:addons in Firefox, then pick "Install Add-on From File" from the gear menu.
Install.step3: Open your Amazon.co.jp order history. Kindle orders are hidden right away.
Install.note: It is signed, so no developer settings or unsigned-extension workarounds are needed.

CTA.title: Clear the clutter.
CTA.description: One file, one click, and your order history is readable again.
